steps.welcome: Take a quick tour of Lettuce — a look around the menu on the left and the icons up top. You can skip anytime and replay it later; every feature page also has its own "How … works" walkthrough.
steps.dashboard: Dashboard — your managers, peers, subordinates and teams at a glance.
steps.kudos: Kudos — the public wall of appreciation from across the organization.
steps.feedback: Feedback — give, request and read feedback.
steps.oneOnOnes: 1:1 meetings — the documented outcomes of your one-on-ones.
steps.myGoals: Goals — the goals set for you, and the ones you set as a manager.
steps.impactLog: Impact log — your personal journal of accomplishments.
steps.career: Career — your position history; managers also see their team pyramid.
steps.daysOff: Days off — the team calendar, your own days off and your paid-days budget.
steps.teamKpis: Team KPIs — the measurable indicators your teams track over time.
steps.performance: Performance — your performance reviews; managers also run their team's.
steps.pulse: Pulse — the recurring anonymous survey and your team's results.
steps.succession: Succession plans — your private planning space for critical seats and their successors.
steps.config: Config — users, teams, the org chart, feedback templates and the registries; administrators also manage pulse cycles, feature flags, integration clients and alerts here.
steps.dictionaries: Dictionaries — the shared lists the app picks from: career paths, specializations, seniority levels and pulse questions.
steps.account: Change password — update your password here.
steps.changelog: Changelog — what's new in each release; a red dot on the version stamp marks changes you haven't seen yet.
steps.notifications: Notifications — the bell lights up when something concerns you.
steps.language: Switch the interface language at any time.
steps.logout: Your account menu — notification settings, every tutorial under Tutorials, and sign out when you're done.
steps.replay: That's it! Replay this tour anytime from here — and look for the "How … works" button on each feature page, or open Tutorials in your account menu, for a guided walkthrough.
